AGENTX_BENCHMARK_HARNESS_URL.description: Credential-free HTTP(S) origin of the external benchmark harness broker. Unset while BENCHMARK_HARNESS_ENABLED=true: broker calls fail with HARNESS_BROKER_NOT_CONFIGURED (503).

AGENTX_CLASSIFIER_RESPECT_PRIMARY_PIN.description: false lets the request classifier use its configured model instead of the primary host pin. Unset: the pin is respected.

AGENTX_CODING_CONFIG.description: Path of the coding dispatcher JSON config read for the OpenClaw model-policy projection. Unset: reads config/coding-dispatcher.json under AGENTX_INSTANCE_ROOT, AGENTX_REPO_ROOT or /etc/agentx.

AGENTX_DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL.description: Default chat model for Core routing and the Benchmark judge fallback. Unset: gemma4:26b-a4b-it-qat in Core, llama3.2:3b for the judge.

AGENTX_EXTERNAL_CONSUMER_TOKEN.description: Token required from the VoiX voice-memory consumer. Unset: that consumer answers 503 not configured.

AGENTX_FACE_UNLOCK_ENABLED.description: true enables face unlock of the adult space once a parental code exists (configured or set from the host). Any other value or unset: face unlock is off.

AGENTX_FACE_UNLOCK_MAX_DISTANCE.description: Maximum face-descriptor distance accepted by face unlock, from 0.3 to 0.5; a value outside that range fails startup. Unset: 0.4.

AGENTX_HOST_HOME_LABEL.description: Label of the "back to host" link shown in Core pages, trimmed to 80 characters. Unset: "Back to host". Only used when AGENTX_HOST_HOME_URL is set.

AGENTX_HOST_HOME_URL.description: Same-origin absolute path (starting with /) of a host home page linked from Core pages. Unset or not a path: no link is shown.

AGENTX_INSTANCE_ROOT.description: Container path of the mounted external instance directory read by runtime bridges (agent registry, coding dispatcher config). Unset: falls back to AGENTX_REPO_ROOT, then a built-in default.

AGENTX_OLLAMA_ALLOWED_TARGETS.description: Comma-separated extra Ollama origins on non-standard ports that the Benchmark setup and profiler may target. Unset: only port 11434 or already configured targets are admitted.

AGENTX_OPENCLAW_MANIFEST_MAX_AGE_MS.description: Maximum age of the OpenClaw manifest in the agent-ops projection before it counts as stale. Unset: a built-in default.

AGENTX_PARENTAL_CODE.description: Optional parental code that unlocks the adult space through the gateway and bearer access; when set it takes precedence and cannot be changed from the UI. Unset: the code is set and changed from the unlock page and stored hashed in MongoDB; until it is set from the AgentX host, adult pages stay locked.

AGENTX_PARENTAL_SESSION_MINUTES.description: Lifetime in minutes of an adult session after unlock, from 5 to 480; a value outside that range fails startup. Unset: 30.

AGENTX_PLATFORM_MAP_PATH.description: Path of the platform map read for host usage aggregation. Unset: the built-in default paths.

AGENTX_PRINTER_VISION_ENABLED.description: true registers the /api/printer-vision routes in Core. Any other value or unset: the printer evidence adapter is not loaded.

AGENTX_PROFILE.description: Runtime profile, demo or full. demo disables operator, household and integration routes; full enables them and Benchmark claim recovery. Unset: demo.

AGENTX_RAG_EVENT_THROTTLE_MS.description: Minimum interval between RAG ingest progress events. Unset: 3000 ms.

AGENTX_REPO_ROOT.description: Instance root used by runtime bridges when AGENTX_INSTANCE_ROOT is unset. Unset: a built-in default path.

AGENTX_RESTORE_REHEARSAL_ENABLED.description: true allows restore rehearsal in Core backups and RAG Qdrant snapshots. Any other value or unset: restore rehearsal is refused.

AGENTX_RUNTIME_BRIDGES_ENABLED.description: true registers the OpenClaw, Hermes, DSH and coding runtime bridges in Core (full profile). Any other value or unset: the bridges are not loaded.

AGENTX_TASK_FALLBACK_WAIT_MS.description: How long a busy, claimed or blocked primary is re-checked before a light task degrades to its fallback ladder, at most 10000. Unset: 2000 ms.

AGENTX_TASK_FALLBACKS_JSON.description: One-line JSON ladder of {model, host} fallbacks per light task type. Unset: no task degrades; an invalid value is rejected as a whole at startup.

ALERT_RENOTIFY_MAX_MS.description: Cap on the growing re-notification interval of a firing alert. Unset: 21600000 (6 h).

ALERT_STALE_RESOLVE_MS.description: Age after which an alert that stopped firing is resolved as stale. Unset: 900000 (15 minutes).

ALERT_STALE_SWEEP_MS.description: Interval of the stale alert sweep. Unset: 300000 (5 minutes).

AQI_INTERVAL_MS.description: Poll interval of the Data air-quality feed. Unset: 1 hour.

AQI_MAX_AGE_MS.description: Retention of Data air-quality points. Unset: 30 days.

BACKUP_INTERVAL_MS.description: Backup interval, used only when BACKUP_SCHEDULE_CRON is set to an empty string. Unset: a built-in default.

BACKUP_MAX_RETRIES.description: Retries of a failed scheduled backup. Unset: a built-in default.

BACKUP_OWNER_GID.description: Group id applied to written backup files. Unset: ownership is left unchanged.

BACKUP_OWNER_UID.description: User id applied to written backup files. Unset: ownership is left unchanged.

BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Days backups are kept; 0 keeps them forever. Unset: 30.

BACKUP_RETRY_DELAY_MS.description: Delay before retrying a failed scheduled backup. Unset: a built-in default.

BACKUP_SCHEDULE_CRON.description: Cron expression of scheduled backups. Unset: a default daily cron; an empty string uses BACKUP_INTERVAL_MS instead.

BACKUP_SCHEDULE_TZ.description: Time zone of the backup cron. Unset: PLANNING_TIME_ZONE or its default.

BACKUP_STARTUP_DELAY_MS.description: Delay after startup before the backup scheduler runs. Unset: a built-in default.

BASIC_HEALTH_OLLAMA_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of the basic Ollama health probe. Unset: a built-in default.

BATCH_MAX_DOCS.description: Maximum documents per RAG batch ingest, from 1 to 500. Unset: 50.

BENCHMARK_CLAIM_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS.description: How long a benchmark host claim waits for other work to drain. Unset: 30000 ms.

BENCHMARK_CLAIM_FINALIZE_HEARTBEAT_MS.description: Heartbeat interval of a finalizing benchmark claim. Unset: 60000 ms, bounded by the finalize TTL.

BENCHMARK_CLAIM_REAP_INTERVAL_MS.description: Interval of the stale benchmark claim reaper in Core. Unset: 300000 (5 minutes).

BENCHMARK_CODE_RUNNER.description: Code runner mode for coding prompts with reference tests: volume (sidecar), local (refused in production) or off. Unset: volume when the jobs directory exists, otherwise off; unknown values mean off.

BENCHMARK_HARNESS_ENABLED.description: true enables the external benchmark harness broker (needs AGENTX_BENCHMARK_HARNESS_URL) and skips the setup redirect. Any other value or unset: the broker is off.

BENCHMARK_PUBLIC_URL.description: Browser-facing Benchmark URL used for Core portal links and accepted as a parental-gateway origin. Compose sets it from BENCHMARK_PORT; unset natively: no Benchmark link.

BENCHMARK_TERMINAL_FAILURE_RATE_THRESHOL.description: Failure rate, 0 to 1, at which a benchmark batch is treated as failing. Unset: 0.25.

BUDGET_CLOUD_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated host patterns counted as cloud in budget accounting. Unset: built-in patterns.

BUDGET_CLOUD_PROVIDERS.description: Comma-separated providers counted as cloud in budget accounting. Unset: built-in providers.

CALLER_ABORT_RECOVERY_SETTLE_MS.description: Wait before the watchdog releases a caller-aborted inference whose model is resident at its context, at least 15000. Unset: 60000.

CELESTRAK_GP_URL.description: Source URL of the Data satellites TLE feed. Unset: the CelesTrak stations group.

CHAT_RAG_MIN_SCORE.description: Cosine floor, 0 to 1, for semantic chat RAG context. Unset or invalid: 0.3.

CLAWDX_OLLAMA_URL.description: Ollama URL checked as the ClawdX host by operations health. Unset: OLLAMA_HOST_TERTIARY, OLLAMA_HOST_3, then a default.

CLOUD_DAILY_TOKEN_LIMIT.description: Daily billable cloud token limit for the budget gate. Unset: DAILY_TOKEN_LIMIT.

CODEX_SUBSCRIPTION_MONTHLY_USD.description: Monthly Codex subscription cost used in usage-value analytics. Unset: no cost is shown.

CODEX_SUBSCRIPTION_PLAN_NAME.description: Codex plan name shown in usage analytics. Unset: the plan type reported by the account.

CODING_DELIVERY_COMPOSE_OVERRIDE.description: Compose override file passed to the read-only production delivery probe on the delivery host. Unset: the probe uses no override.

CODING_DELIVERY_DEPLOY_WORKFLOW.description: GitHub deployment workflow observed by coding delivery. Unset: none.

CODING_DELIVERY_ENV_FILE.description: Instance env file on the delivery host used by the read-only production delivery probe. Unset: the production probe is not configured and reports unavailable.

CODING_DELIVERY_GITHUB_REPOSITORY.description: owner/name GitHub repository observed for coding delivery. Unset: WindriderQc/AgentX; an invalid value makes delivery report a configuration error.

CODING_DELIVERY_GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub token used to read pull requests and workflow runs for coding delivery. Unset: GitHub delivery observation reports not configured.

CODING_DELIVERY_LEGACY_PRODUCT_ENABLED.description: true enables reading old receipts from the legacy product repository. Unset: off.

CODING_DELIVERY_PROJECT_NAME.description: Compose project name inspected by the production delivery probe. Unset: agentx.

CODING_DELIVERY_PROMOTION_RECEIPT_ROOT.description: Absolute directory on the delivery host holding coding promotion receipts. Unset: /home/agentx/.local/state/agentx/coding-promotions.

CODING_DELIVERY_REMOTE_ROOT.description: Absolute checkout path on the delivery host inspected by the production delivery probe. Unset: /srv/agentx/AgentX.

CODING_DELIVERY_SSH_TARGET.description: user@host SSH target of the read-only production delivery probe. Unset: the production probe is not configured and reports unavailable.

CODING_DISPATCHER_REMOTE_ROOT.description: Absolute checkout path of the coding dispatcher scripts on its SSH host, also the Secretary mail fallback root. Unset: /srv/agentx/AgentX; an invalid path fails bridge startup.

CODING_DISPATCHER_SSH_TARGET.description: user@host SSH target where Core launches coding dispatcher runs. Unset: dispatch reports unavailable; an invalid value fails bridge startup.

COMPRESSION_CACHE_TTL.description: Cache lifetime of RAG compressed chunks in milliseconds. Unset: 1 hour.

COMPRESSION_CONCURRENCY.description: Parallel RAG chunk compression calls. Unset: 2.

CONTEXT_PROBE_CPU_MAX_CTX.description: Largest context the Profiler probes on a CPU-resident host. Unset: 32768.

CONTEXT_PROBE_CPU_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Per-step timeout of the Profiler context probe on a CPU-resident host, and the minimum bound of every other Profiler request there, in ms. Unset: 1200000.

CONTEXT_PROBE_MAX_CTX.description: Largest context tried by the Benchmark context probe. Unset: a built-in default.

CONTEXT_PROBE_MIN_COMPLETION_TOKENS.description: Minimum tokens a context probe completion must produce. Unset: half of CONTEXT_PROBE_NUM_PREDICT, at least 4.

CONTEXT_PROBE_MIN_CTX.description: Smallest context tried by the Benchmark context probe. Unset: a built-in default.

CONTEXT_PROBE_NUM_PREDICT.description: Tokens generated per context probe step. Unset: 64.

CONTEXT_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of one context probe step. Unset: a built-in default.

CORE_INTERNAL_URL.description: URL household code uses to call Core itself. Unset: http://127.0.0.1:3080.

CORE_LEADER_LEASE_ENABLED.description: Enables the Core leader lease. Unset: off.

CORE_PUBLIC_URL.description: Browser-facing Core URL used for portal links, the parental gateway unlock redirect and runtime-bridge exports. Unset: bridges derive it from the request host and the unlock redirect is skipped.

COST_CURRENCY.description: Currency label of cost analytics. Unset: USD.

COST_PRICING_CACHE_TTL.description: Pricing cache lifetime in seconds. Unset: 3600.

COST_TRACKING_ENABLED.description: false disables cost calculation. Unset: on.

DAILY_TOKEN_LIMIT.description: Daily token limit used for budget health. Unset: 500000.

DATA_BACKGROUND_JOBS_ENABLED.description: true starts Data background feeds and janitor schedules (outside tests). Any other value or unset: only manual Data APIs run.

DATA_COLLECTOR_PLACEMENT_JSON.description: JSON display map (network/storage rows with host, supervisor, runtime, cadence) for Data Toolbox collectors, at most 32 KiB. Unset: the Toolbox shows registrations only.

DATA_HARDWARE_HISTORY_TTL_DAYS.description: Retention in days of GPU hardware sample history, at most 90, applied to the TTL index at startup. Unset or invalid: 7 days.

DATA_PATH_ROLE_ALIASES_FILE.description: Container path of an out-of-Git JSON file adding folder-name aliases to Data path roles. Unset: never read; an invalid file logs one warning and built-in roles apply.

DATA_TOOLBOX_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of Data Toolbox relay requests, 1000 to 30000. Unset: 10000.

DATAAPI_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the Data service read by Core (Toolbox, hardware, health) and Benchmark (hardware collector). Unset: Core uses http://data:3083; Benchmark skips hardware collection.

DATAAPI_PUBLIC_URL.description: Browser-facing Data URL for links and parental-gateway origins. Unset: no Data link.

DEFAULT_FALLBACK_COMPLETION_COST_PER_1M.description: Completion cost per million tokens for models without pricing. Unset: 0.

DEFAULT_FALLBACK_PROMPT_COST_PER_1M.description: Prompt cost per million tokens for models without pricing. Unset: 0.

DEGRADED_FALLBACK.description: true allows one retry on another host after a failed dispatch for interactive lanes. Unset: off.

DSH_STUDIO_ACCESS_SECRET.description: HMAC secret, at least 32 characters, signing DSH Studio launch tokens. Required when DSH_STUDIO_PUBLIC_URL is set; shorter or unset then fails bridge startup.

DSH_STUDIO_ISOLATION.description: DSH Studio isolation, bubblewrap or host. Unset: bubblewrap.

DSH_STUDIO_MODEL.description: Model name displayed for DSH Studio in the agent-ops projection and studio config. Unset: no model is shown.

DSH_STUDIO_PUBLIC_URL.description: HTTPS origin (HTTP on loopback) of DSH Studio, same hostname as CORE_PUBLIC_URL. Unset: DSH Studio is not configured and its launcher is hidden.

DSH_STUDIO_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS.description: DSH Studio launch session lifetime in seconds, at least 300. Unset: a built-in default.

ECOSYSTEM_SNAPSHOT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of the ecosystem snapshot. Unset: a built-in default.

EMBED_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of the embedding host probe. Unset: 3000 ms.

EMBED_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of one embedding request. Unset: 60000 ms.

EMBEDDING_CACHE_SIZE.description: Entries kept in the RAG embedding cache. Unset: 1000.

EMBEDDING_CACHE_TTL_MS.description: Lifetime of RAG embedding cache entries. Unset: 24 hours.

EMBEDDING_DIMENSION.description: Vector dimension of the RAG embedding model, used for the Qdrant collection and migrations. Unset: 768.

EMBEDDING_HEALTH_TTL_MS.description: Cache lifetime of the RAG embedding health check. Unset: 300000 ms.

EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: Embedding model RAG requests through the Core proxy. Unset: nomic-embed-text:v1.5. Similarity floors were measured with that model.

FINANCE_ALERT_CATEGORY_SPIKE_CENTS.description: Minimum monthly increase in cents, with a 50 % rise, for a category spike finance alert. Unset: 10000 (100 $).

FINANCE_ALERT_LARGE_EXPENSE_CENTS.description: Amount in cents above which an expense in the last 45 days raises a finance alert. Unset: 100000 (1 000 $).

FINANCE_ALERT_MIN_BALANCE_ACCOUNTS.description: Comma-separated accounts checked by the minimum-balance finance alert. Unset: EOP.

FINANCE_ALERT_MIN_BALANCE_CENTS.description: Balance in cents under which the listed accounts raise a finance alert. Unset: 0, so the minimum-balance alert is off.

FINANCE_ALERT_STALE_DAYS.description: Days without a new statement before a finance alert is raised. Unset: 45.

FINANCE_ARCHIVE_PATH.description: Absolute directory where reconciled statements move, under <year>/. Unset or relative: the finance inbox is off.

FINANCE_EXTRACTION_MODEL.description: Model pinned for statement extraction and finance suggestions. Unset: the analysis route selects the model.

FINANCE_EXTRACTION_RETRIES.description: Retries after a statement fails to reconcile, from 0 to 5. Unset: 3.

FINANCE_INBOX_PATH.description: Absolute directory scanned for bank and credit-card statements to ingest. Unset or relative: the finance inbox is off.

FINANCE_INBOX_POLL_MS.description: Finance inbox scan interval in milliseconds, at least 60000. Unset or lower: 900000 (15 minutes).

FINANCE_REVIEW_PATH.description: Absolute directory where statements that do not reconcile move. Unset: <inbox>/a-verifier.

GATE_ENABLED.description: false disables the per-host, per-model admission gate. Unset: on.

GATE_MAX_INFLIGHT.description: Maximum in-flight requests per host and model in the admission gate; a registered host's own limit (Nerve Center, Inference hosts) wins. Unset: 2.

GATE_SHARED_RETRY_MS.description: Retry interval for a shared admission slot. Unset: 100 ms.

GATE_SHARED_SLOT_TTL_MS.description: Lifetime of a shared admission slot, at least 60000. Unset: 30 minutes.

GATE_SHARED_STATE_ENABLED.description: Enables shared admission gate state (1, true, yes, on). Unset: off.

HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS.description: Interval of the host health daemon. Unset: 60000 ms.

HEALTH_REFRESH_MS.description: Interval of the Core health refresh timer. Unset: 30000 ms.

HERMES_API_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of the Hermes status request. Unset: 5000 ms.

HERMES_AUTHORITY_CONTEXT.description: Positive integer context size exported for the Hermes authority model. Unset: the daily lane context for a local model, none for a cloud model.

HERMES_AUTHORITY_MODEL.description: Model exported as Hermes authority and added to its approved models. Unset: the daily lane model.

HERMES_DASHBOARD_URL.description: Hermes dashboard URL polled for status evidence and shown as its host. Unset: falls back to HERMES_PUBLIC_URL; with neither, Hermes status answers 503.

HERMES_GATEWAY_STALE_MS.description: Age after which Hermes gateway evidence is stale, at least 60000. Unset: 24 hours.

HERMES_OPENAI_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Inference timeout for the Hermes OpenAI-compatible bridge. Unset: the inference default.

HERMES_PUBLIC_URL.description: Browser-facing Hermes URL shown in the agent-ops projection and used for status when HERMES_DASHBOARD_URL is unset. Unset: host shows "external runtime".

HOST_BASELINE_MODEL.description: Baseline model for Benchmark host tests.

HOST_TEST_CONTEXT_FILL_PCT.description: Percent of num_ctx filled by a host test prompt. Unset: 25.

HOST_TEST_MAX_PROMPT_TOKENS.description: Maximum prompt tokens of a host test. Unset: 2048.

HOST_TEST_NUM_PREDICT.description: Tokens generated by a host test. Unset: 64.

HOST_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Per-model host test timeout. Unset: 60000 ms.

HOST_TEST_WARMUP.description: false disables host test warm-up. Unset: on.

HOUSEHOLD_AVATAR_MODULE_URL.description: URL of the GraphysX llmx-face.js module relayed by Core for the avatar dock. Unset: the relay answers 404 and the dock shows a 2D orb.

HOUSEHOLD_BROWSER_STT_FALLBACK.description: Allow the browser's own speech recognition when local transcription (VoiX) is unavailable: false, personal (Super Dad only) or true (Super Dad and Famille). Each browser must still consent per space; Chrome and Edge send the audio to the vendor's cloud. Unset: off.

HOUSEHOLD_BRAIN_ENABLED.description: Run a bounded background review after each Household turn. Unset: enabled in Compose.

HOUSEHOLD_BRAIN_FAMILY.description: Allow the background review on the Famille surface. Unset: enabled in Compose.

HOUSEHOLD_PERSONA_VOICES.description: Optional JSON mapping a Household persona id, or "*", to an instance voice "provider|voice" (kokoro, windows_sapi or voxcpm). A browser voice selection still wins. Unset: catalog voices.

HOUSEHOLD_BRAIN_EXCLUSIVE.description: Ask for exclusive admission on HOUSEHOLD_BRAIN_HOST_URL for background reviews (waits for an idle host, blocks other callers, unloads co-resident models). Unset: shared admission.

HOUSEHOLD_BRAIN_HOST_URL.description: Optional Ollama host pinned for Household background reviews so they do not compete with voice inference. Unset: use router selection.

HOUSEHOLD_BRAIN_MODEL.description: Optional Ollama model for Household background reviews. Unset: use the router master_brain lane.

HOUSEHOLD_CONVERSATION_BACKEND.description: Household conversation engine: auto, agentx or openclaw. auto selects OpenClaw only when its gateway URL and token are set. Unset: auto.

HOUSEHOLD_IMAGE_FAMILY_SOURCES.description: Image source types Famille may show. Unset: web, photos, media and generated images.

HOUSEHOLD_IMAGE_ROOTS_JSON.description: JSON mapping of Household image sources to canonical Data indexed roots. Unset: no local source roots.

HOUSEHOLD_PERMISSIVE_PRIMARY_MODEL.description: Model of the household permissive personal-operator pack. Unset: a built-in default model.

HOUSEHOLD_VOICE_MODEL.description: provider/model sent to OpenClaw for personal Nestor voice turns on the main agent. Unset: native OpenClaw model policy applies.

IMAGE_ARCHIVE_DIR.description: Writable directory, inside the Core container, where the original of every attached photo and every generated image is kept at full quality. Unset: nothing is archived.

INFERENCE_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of one inference request. Unset: 600000 ms.

INFERENCE_LOG_TTL_DAYS.description: Retention of InferenceLog rows in days. Unset: 30.

INGEST_BATCH_DELAY_MS.description: Delay between RAG ingest batches. Unset: a built-in default.

INGEST_MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES.description: Largest file RAG ingests, capped by the ingestion policy. Unset: a built-in default.

INGEST_ROOTS.description: Comma-separated RAG ingest roots, which must lie inside the approved roots. Unset: the policy roots.

ISS_API_URL.description: Source URL of the Data ISS position feed. Unset: wheretheiss.at.

ISS_INTERVAL_MS.description: Poll interval of the Data ISS feed. Unset: 60000 ms.

JANITOR_ALLOWED_ROOTS.description: Comma-separated roots the Data janitor may scan or clean. Unset: /mnt/datalake/.

JANITOR_EXECUTION_ENABLED.description: true allows live janitor maintenance. Unset: only previews run.

JANITOR_PREVIEW_TTL_MS.description: Lifetime of a janitor preview. Unset: a built-in default.

JUDGE_FALLBACK_MODEL.description: Judge model used when the requested judge is not valid on the judge host. Unset: no fallback.

JUDGE_HOST.description: Ollama host of the Benchmark judge. Unset: OLLAMA_HOST.

JUDGE_MODEL.description: Benchmark judge model selected by the operator. Unset: AGENTX_DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL, then llama3.2:3b.

JUDGE_NUM_CTX.description: num_ctx sent to the Benchmark judge. Unset: omitted.

JUDGE_NUM_PREDICT.description: Tokens the Benchmark judge may generate. Unset: 800.

JUDGE_SEED.description: Seed of the Benchmark judge; an empty string disables it. Unset: 7.

JUDGE_TEMPERATURE.description: Temperature of the Benchmark judge. Unset: 0.1.

LEANTIME_BASE_URL.description: Leantime URL for household email actions and agent-ops links. Unset: email actions answer 503.

MAIL_JOURNAL_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Days a mail journal entry is kept, counted from the mail's date; Mongo removes it afterwards. Applies to entries recorded after a change. 0 keeps entries forever; an invalid value uses 365.

MEMORY_REVIEW_AUTOMATION_MODE.description: Memory review automation: off, shadow or safe; only safe applies automatically. Unset: off.

MEMORY_REVIEW_DUPLICATE_SCORE.description: Score above which a memory review candidate is a duplicate. Unset: 0.8.

MEMORY_REVIEW_EXCEPTION_BUDGET.description: Maximum review exceptions per memory review run. Unset: a built-in limit.

MEMORY_REVIEW_JOB_ID.description: Expected id of the memory-review-shadow job in coverage checks. Unset: matched by name only.

MEMORY_REVIEW_RAG_MIN_SCORE.description: Cosine floor of memory review searches. Unset: 0.55.

MEMORY_REVIEW_RAG_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of memory review RAG searches, 1000 to 20000. Unset: 5000.

MEMORY_SEARCH_MIN_SCORE.description: Cosine floor of memory reads without an explicit floor. Unset: 0.6.

MODEL_HEALTH_CACHE_TTL_MS.description: Cache lifetime of model health checks. Unset: 1000 ms.

MODEL_HEALTH_SLOW_THRESHOLD_MS.description: Latency above which a model health check is slow. Unset: 6000 ms.

MODEL_HEALTH_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of a model health check. Unset: 3000 ms.

MODEL_SYNC_UNCONFIGURED_HOST_RETIRE_GRAC.description: Grace before model sync retires models of an unconfigured host. Unset: a built-in default.

MONGODB_TEST_SERVER_SELECTION_TIMEOUT_MS.description: MongoDB server selection timeout in tests. Unset: a built-in default.

MONGODB_URI_TEST.description: Isolated MongoDB URI used when NODE_ENV=test. Benchmark tests require it.

MQTT_BROKER_URL.description: MQTT broker for Data live feeds. Unset: MQTT is skipped.

MQTT_ISS_TOPIC.description: MQTT topic of ISS positions. Unset: liveData/iss.

MQTT_PASSWORD.description: Password of the Data MQTT connection.

MQTT_PRESSURE_TOPIC.description: MQTT topic of weather pressure. Unset: liveData/pressure.

MQTT_USERNAME.description: Username of the Data MQTT connection.

N8N_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL.description: n8n base URL combined with N8N_WEBHOOK_GENERIC when N8N_WEBHOOK_URL is unset.

N8N_WEBHOOK_GENERIC.description: n8n webhook path appended to N8N_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL.

N8N_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Full n8n webhook URL used by Data storage. Unset: base URL plus generic path, or none.

NESTOR_KNOWLEDGE_CONFIG_PATH.description: Path of the Nestor family knowledge configuration. Unset: the built-in empty, disabled configuration.

NESTOR_MEMORY_RAG_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of Nestor memory RAG calls, 1000 to 30000. Unset: 5000.

NETWORK_DEVICE_WATCH_MS.description: Interval at which Core checks the Data network inventory for new unknown devices, minimum 60000. Unset: no check and no network-new-device alert.

NETWORK_SCAN_CIDR.description: Default IPv4 address or CIDR target of the Data network scan. Unset: a scan needs an explicit target in the request.

OBSIDIAN_VAULT_POLICY_PATH.description: External policy file of the Data Obsidian inventory. Unset: the inventory refuses to load.

OLLAMA_ANALYSIS_MODEL.description: Prompt analysis model when PROMPT_ANALYSIS_MODEL is unset. Unset: OLLAMA_MODEL, then AGENTX_DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL.

OLLAMA_HOST.description: URL of the first Ollama host for Core and Benchmark (key primary). Further hosts are registered in the Nerve Center (Inference hosts). Compose sets it from AGENTX_OLLAMA_HOST; unset natively: Core warns and model features using it are unavailable until a host is registered.

OLLAMA_HOST_NAME.description: Display name of the primary Ollama host. Unset: Local Ollama.

OLLAMA_HOST_SECONDARY.description: URL of the secondary Ollama host. Unset: OLLAMA_HOST_2.

OLLAMA_HOST_TERTIARY.description: URL of the tertiary Ollama host. Unset: OLLAMA_HOST_3.

OLLAMA_HOST_VRAM_MAP.description: Comma-separated host=MB or host:port=MB VRAM sizes; a port-qualified entry wins, so two Ollama instances of one machine stay distinct. Unset: VRAM is not declared.

OLLAMA_MODEL.description: Legacy default chat model after AGENTX_DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL and AGENTX_CHAT_MODEL.

OLLAMA_MODEL_START_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of an Ollama model start. Unset: a built-in default.

OLLAMA_PULL_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of an Ollama model pull. Unset: a built-in default.

OLLAMA_SSH_KEY_PATH.description: SSH key used when OPENCLAW_INVENTORY_SSH_KEY_PATH is unset.

OLLAMA_SSH_STRICT_HOST_KEY_CHECKING.description: SSH StrictHostKeyChecking when the OpenClaw inventory value is unset. Unset: no.

OLLAMA_VRAM_CACHE_MS.description: Cache lifetime of Benchmark Ollama VRAM reads. Unset: a built-in default.

OPEN_METEO_AQI_URL.description: Source URL of the Data air-quality feed. Unset: Open-Meteo.

OPENCLAW_AGENTX_PROVIDER_BASE_URL.description: Absolute URL, without credentials, query or fragment, exported to OpenClaw as its AgentX provider. Unset: derived from CORE_PUBLIC_URL plus the OpenClaw route.

OPENCLAW_AGENTX_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Inference timeout for the OpenClaw runtime bridge. Unset: the inference default.

OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH.description: Path of openclaw.json read for agent inventory and the gateway token fallback. Unset: openclaw.json under OPENCLAW_HOME.

OPENCLAW_CONTROL_UI_LOCAL_URL.description: Local URL of the OpenClaw Control UI used in ssh-tunnel mode. Unset: http://127.0.0.1:18790.

OPENCLAW_CONTROL_UI_MODE.description: OpenClaw Control UI launch mode; ssh-tunnel or tunnel opens the local tunnel URL. Unset or other: direct.

OPENCLAW_CONTROL_UI_PUBLIC_URL.description: Direct URL of the OpenClaw Control UI; with OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN it adds the OpenClaw launcher. Unset: the launcher is hidden and direct mode uses the gateway URL.

OPENCLAW_CONVERSATION_FALLBACK_TASK.description: Task whose fallback ladder an OpenClaw conversation borrows when its primary is unavailable, e.g. nestor_answer_light. Unset: the conversation keeps its busy reply.

OPENCLAW_CONVERSATION_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated model=http://host:port entries routing an OpenClaw conversation model to one inference host. Unset: the routed task model applies; an invalid entry fails bridge startup.

OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for the OpenClaw gateway, used by Nestor household conversations and the Control UI. Unset: household OpenClaw is unavailable and the Control UI reads the token from openclaw.json.

OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL.description: URL of the OpenClaw gateway used by Nestor household conversations and continuity. Unset: household OpenClaw is unavailable; the Control UI assumes http://127.0.0.1:18789.

OPENCLAW_HOME.description: Local OpenClaw home directory for inventory and config lookups. Unset: ~/.openclaw for inventory, /data/openclaw for the Control UI token lookup.

OPENCLAW_INVENTORY_REMOTE_CLI_HOME.description: OPENCLAW_HOME value prefixed to OpenClaw CLI commands run over SSH. Unset: no prefix is added.

OPENCLAW_INVENTORY_REMOTE_HOME.description: OpenClaw home directory on the SSH inventory host. Unset: /home/agentx/.openclaw.

OPENCLAW_INVENTORY_SSH_BIN.description: SSH executable for bridge SSH calls. Unset: ssh.

OPENCLAW_INVENTORY_SSH_KEY_PATH.description: Private key file used for SSH to the OpenClaw, dispatcher and mail hosts. Unset: OLLAMA_SSH_KEY_PATH, otherwise the default SSH identity.

OPENCLAW_INVENTORY_SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_PATH.description: known_hosts file used when strict host key checking is on. Unset: known_hosts beside the SSH key, if one is set.

OPENCLAW_INVENTORY_SSH_PORT.description: SSH port for the OpenClaw inventory and related bridge SSH calls. Unset: the SSH default port.

OPENCLAW_INVENTORY_SSH_STRICT_HOST_KEY_C.description: SSH StrictHostKeyChecking for bridge SSH calls. Unset: OLLAMA_SSH_STRICT_HOST_KEY_CHECKING, then no.

OPENCLAW_INVENTORY_SSH_TARGET.description: user@host where Core reads OpenClaw inventory and runtime evidence and runs Secretary mail actions over SSH. Unset: inventory is read locally and mail actions are unavailable.

OPENCLAW_INVENTORY_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of OpenClaw inventory commands. Unset: a built-in default.

OPENCLAW_RUNTIME_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of OpenClaw runtime evidence commands. Unset: 25000 ms.

OPENCLAW_RUNTIME_EVIDENCE_CACHE_MS.description: Cache lifetime of OpenClaw runtime evidence. Unset: 15000 ms.

PIN_CONTEXT_SPEED_TOLERANCE_PCT.description: Allowed speed loss, 0 to 50 percent, when applying a pin context. Unset: 10.

PIN_RESTORE_GRACE_MS.description: Wait after a pin is displaced before it is restored. Unset: 120000 ms.

PIN_RESTORE_VERIFY_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout verifying a restored pin, at least 1000. Unset: a built-in default.

PIN_WARM_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout warming a pinned model, at least 30000. Unset: a built-in default.

PLANNING_TIME_ZONE.description: Time zone of family planning and the default backup schedule. Unset: a built-in default.

PORTAL_HEALTH_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of portal service health probes. Unset: 1500 ms.

PROFILER_MATRIX_DECODE_TOKENS.description: Comma-separated decode lengths of the profiler matrix. Unset: built-in values.

PROFILER_MATRIX_PREFILL_TOKENS.description: Comma-separated prefill lengths of the profiler matrix. Unset: built-in values.

PROFILER_RECONCILIATION_DELAY_MS.description: Delay before profiler projection recovery. Unset: a built-in default.

PROFILER_RECONCILIATION_INTERVAL_MS.description: Interval of profiler projection recovery. Unset: a built-in default.

PROMPT_ANALYSIS_MODEL.description: Model of prompt analysis. Unset: OLLAMA_ANALYSIS_MODEL, OLLAMA_MODEL, then AGENTX_DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL.

PROMPT_ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of prompt analysis. Unset: 120000 ms.

PSYX_ACCESS_MODE.description: PsyX access mode: token (access code required) or trusted-network (no locking, an operator decision); another value fails startup. Unset: token.

PSYX_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Private access code that unlocks PsyX in token mode. Unset: PsyX private APIs stay locked.

PSYX_LOOPBACK_BYPASS.description: true lets loopback requests bypass the PsyX access code. Any other value or unset: loopback requests need the code too.

PSYX_VOICE_MODE.description: PsyX voice mode: disabled or voix (requires a valid VOIX_BASE_URL); another value fails startup. Unset: disabled.

QDRANT_COLLECTION.description: Qdrant collection RAG reads, writes and snapshots. Compose default agentx_product_embeddings; unset natively: agentx_embeddings.

QDRANT_SNAPSHOT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of Qdrant snapshot requests for backups. Unset: 120000 ms.

QUAKES_API_URL.description: Source URL of the Data earthquake feed. Unset: USGS daily CSV.

QUAKES_INTERVAL_MS.description: Poll interval of the Data earthquake feed. Unset: 24 hours.

RAG_API_URL.description: RAG base URL used by the ingest worker. Unset: loopback on the RAG port.

RAG_CORPUS_STALE_AFTER_MS.description: Age after the last ingest at which the RAG corpus is reported stale. Unset: 7 days.

RAG_ENABLED.description: true adds RAG context to every chat. Unset: only when the request asks for it.

RAG_EVIDENCE_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of Nerve Center RAG evidence calls, 500 to 15000. Unset: 5000.

RAG_PUBLIC_URL.description: Browser-facing RAG URL used for Core portal links and accepted as a parental-gateway origin. Compose sets it from RAG_PORT; unset natively: no RAG link.

REQUIRE_PROFILED_MODELS.description: true blocks models not profiled on the selected host. Unset: off.

ROUNDTABLE_CHAIR_TOKEN.description: Token required for roundtable chair actions.

ROUNDTABLE_JUDGE_MODEL.description: Model of the roundtable quality judge. Unset: the product default model.

ROUNDTABLE_JUDGE_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of the roundtable quality judge. Unset: 120000 ms.

ROUNDTABLE_RUNTIME_PARTICIPANTS_ENABLED.description: Enables external runtime participants in the roundtable. Unset: off.

ROUTE_RESOLVER_SHADOW.description: true records shadow route resolver comparisons without changing routing. Unset: off.

SATELLITES_INTERVAL_MS.description: Poll interval of the Data satellites feed. Unset: 6 hours.

SATELLITES_MAX_AGE_MS.description: Retention of Data satellite points. Unset: 7 days.

SEARXNG_URL.description: SearXNG URL for web search. Unset: web search answers not configured.

SECRETARY_MAIL_REMOTE_ROOT.description: Checkout path of Secretary mail scripts on the SSH host. Unset: CODING_DISPATCHER_REMOTE_ROOT.

SENSORS_MAX_AGE_MS.description: Retention of Data sensor points. Unset: 30 days.

STORAGE_AGENT_SOURCES.description: JSON registry of Data storage agent sources. Unset: built-in sources.

VAULT_INBOX_PATH.description: Absolute Obsidian vault inbox directory for agent notes. Unset: the capability answers not configured.

VECTOR_STORE_TYPE.description: RAG vector store, qdrant or memory. Unset: RAG refuses to create a store.

VOIX_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the VoiX service for household player, transcription, synthesis and PsyX voice. Unset: VoiX routes answer 503 VOIX_NOT_CONFIGURED.

VOIX_LONG_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of long VoiX calls such as transcription. Unset: 120000 ms.

VOIX_SPOKEN_CONTROLS_ENABLED.description: true sends household transcriptions to the VoiX spoken-controls endpoint (local Stop recognition). Any other value or unset: the ordinary transcription endpoint.

VOIX_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of ordinary VoiX calls. Unset: 10000 ms.

WATCHDOG_INTERVAL_MS.description: Interval of the Ollama watchdog probe. Unset: 60000 ms.

WATCHDOG_MAX_CONSECUTIVE.description: Consecutive failed probes before the watchdog acts. Unset: 2.

WATCHDOG_PROBE_RECOVERY_SETTLE_MS.description: Settle window after a probe recovery, at least 60000. Unset: a built-in default.

WATCHDOG_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout of an Ollama watchdog probe. Unset: 15000 ms.

WATCHDOG_RECOVERY_GRACE_MS.description: Grace after a host recovers during which the watchdog does not unjam. Unset: 5 minutes.

WATCHDOG_RELOAD.description: false stops the watchdog reloading a model after an unjam. Unset: on.

WEATHER_API_URL.description: Source URL of the Data weather feed. Unset: OpenWeatherMap.

WEATHER_INTERVAL_MS.description: Poll interval of the Data weather feed. Unset: 60000 ms.
